parameters.content:
## PR review flow (provider-neutral)

Polling design: n8n cannot receive provider webhooks at `n8n.localhost`, so this workflow **polls** open PRs on a schedule.

Flow: Schedule -> List open PRs -> Dedup -> Get PR diff -> Prepare request -> **Review (judge)** -> Post review comment -> Set commit status -> Build digest -> Notify (swap point) -> Mark reviewed.

The **judge** is a stable contract: input = diff + PR metadata; output = `VERDICT` / `CHECKLIST` / `FINDINGS`. Any reviewer (agent or human) can fill it.

Provider nodes (List/Get diff/Comment/Status) are the **GitHub adapter**; a GitLab variant mirrors them. Keep the merge **gate** in the provider (branch protection / protected branches), not here.

No visibility channel is wired yet: `Notify (swap point)` is a no-op that receives a neutral event. Plug Slack/email/deployment there later.

assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-6-luna', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are an independent, read-only PR reviewer. Review the diff against this checklist: correctness and intent; tests and evidence; docs updated in the same commit; scope and contracts; simplicity and anti-slop (no dead code, unused deps, speculative abstraction); harness changes (flag AGENTS.md, .opencode/**, .claude/**, .github/**, scripts/*, pom.xml, CLAUDE.md); boundaries (no credentials). Cite path:line; separate verified from inference. Do not approve or merge. Output: first line VERDICT: approve | request-changes | comment; then CHECKLIST: item=pass|fail|n-a; then FINDINGS: - [severity] path:line - problem / fix.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Diff: ' + $json.data } ] }) }}

## JUDGE — swap point
Replace this node with a human step (Slack/email/review request) that returns the same `VERDICT` / `CHECKLIST` / `FINDINGS` contract. Nothing downstream changes.

## VISIBILITY — swap point
No-op placeholder. The flow emits a neutral event (`channel, event, title, text, url, meta`).

Plug channels here later (Slack, Teams, email) and, separately, a deployment sink. The review logic does not change. No channel is wired yet.
